name: XT60PW-F
title: XT60PW-F: two-contact PCB-mount socket of the XT60 battery connector family, 30 A, 500 V DC
summary: A two-way female power connector of the Amass XT series for mounting on a printed circuit board. Two gold-plated brass socket contacts sit on 7.20 mm centres in a PA housing rated UL94 V0. It is rated 30 A, with 60 A instantaneous, at DC 500 V, with 0.50 mΩ contact resistance, from -20 to 120 °C. Its recommended use is battery connection, for 1000 mating cycles.

notes: Amass part names are built from fields in this order: series (XT, MT, MR, SH and others); product specification (30, 60, 90, 150 and others); A for a lantern spring contact; insulator specification (PB, PM, PT and others); contact arrangement such as (2+1) or (2+2); gender, -F for a female socket or -M for a male plug; solder tail length, 2 mm or 3 mm; after a slash, contact plating, G for gold or N for nickel; then colour, Y for yellow or B for black.

pins.function: Second socket contact, 7.20 mm from the first.
